Description.SourceString: I found my uncle, my only family, lying on the ground, with an empty stare at the distance. In his cold hands he held a strange sigil I never saw before. Was the killer the one who left that? Did my uncle rip it from him trying to protect himself? We had no enemies in Whisterfield, at least that is what he always said. He never feared the Queen finding us one day. Yet before his death, he spoke of something that troubled him. Now he is gone, and this sigil is all that remains. No one in Whisterfield recognized it. The traders I questioned said the brass it was made from resembled the metalwork they once saw in the Kingdom of Karvenia. If that is true, then the answer may lie far from here. To uncover who was responsible for my uncle’s death, I may have to return to where everything began, my long lost home in the Lowlands.
